block_row: Structural top of the SHA2 and SHA3 hash IP.

frame_row: Structural top of the SHA2 and SHA3 hash IP. It instantiates the blocks below and holds no logic of its own. The AXI4 and register interfaces are on the left, the entropy input on the right.

label: u_axi
(m_vlsit_sha_axi_sub)
blocks.function: AXI4 subordinate. It decodes the context window address, checks burst type, size and strobes, pushes message words, pops digest words and reports window errors.

label: u_csr
(m_vlsit_csr_sha)
blocks.function: Generated APB register block. It holds the control, command, security, status and interrupt registers and crosses between the APB clock and the core clock.

label: u_dma
(m_vlsit_sha_dma)
blocks.function: External DMA handshake. It raises the input and output requests with the four-phase protocol, counts the burst size and pads a short output burst after a timeout.

label: u_irq
(m_vlsit_sha_irq)
blocks.function: Event capture. It collects the error, done and fault events and drives the interrupt and the alarm outputs.

label: u_in_fifo
(m_vlsit_sha_in_fifo)
blocks.function: Input FIFOs, one per context. They hold the message words until a block is complete and give backpressure to the AXI4 write channel when full.

label: u_seq
(m_vlsit_sha_seq)
blocks.function: Context sequencer. It owns the state machine of every context, assembles blocks, adds the padding, picks the next ready context by round robin and counts blocks and bytes.

label: u_ctxmem
(m_vlsit_sha_ctxmem)
blocks.function: Context memory. It stores the hash state of every context that is not in a core, in flip-flops or in an SRAM macro.

label: u_out_fifo
(m_vlsit_sha_out_fifo)
blocks.function: Output FIFOs, one per context. They hold the digest words, or the squeezed words of SHAKE, until the AXI4 read channel or the DMA takes them.

label: u_fault
(m_vlsit_sha_fault)
blocks.function: Fault detection. It compares duplicate cores, checks parity and compares recomputed blocks, then applies the selected responses.

label: u_core256
(m_vlsit_sha_core256)
blocks.function: SHA-224 and SHA-256 compression core with a selectable number of rounds per cycle.

label: u_core512
(m_vlsit_sha_core512)
blocks.function: SHA-384, SHA-512 and SHA-512/t compression core with a selectable number of rounds per cycle.

label: u_keccak
(m_vlsit_sha_keccak)
blocks.function: Keccak permutation core for SHA-3 and SHAKE with a selectable number of rounds per cycle.

label: u_keccak_dom
(m_vlsit_sha_keccak_dom)
blocks.function: Masked Keccak permutation core. It keeps the state as two shares and uses fresh random bits for each non-linear step.

label: u_prng
(m_vlsit_sha_prng)
blocks.function: Random generator of the masked core, seeded from the entropy input or from the seed words of the register block.

interfaces.name: Message words from the AXI4 write channel
interfaces.signals: u_axi -> u_in_fifo: w_in_push, w_in_wdata; u_in_fifo -> u_axi: w_in_full

interfaces.name: Digest words to the AXI4 read channel
interfaces.signals: u_out_fifo -> u_axi: w_out_rdata, w_out_empty; u_axi -> u_out_fifo: w_out_pop

interfaces.name: Message words to the sequencer
interfaces.signals: u_in_fifo -> u_seq: w_in_rdata, w_in_level; u_seq -> u_in_fifo: w_in_pop

interfaces.name: Digest words from the sequencer
interfaces.signals: u_seq -> u_out_fifo: w_out_push, w_out_wdata; u_out_fifo -> u_seq: w_out_full

interfaces.name: Context state read and write
interfaces.signals: u_seq -> u_ctxmem: w_ctx_wr, w_ctx_wstate, w_ctx_rd; u_ctxmem -> u_seq: w_ctx_rstate

interfaces.name: Block and state to the SHA-256 core
interfaces.signals: u_seq -> u_core256: w_c256_start, w_c256_block, w_c256_state; u_core256 -> u_seq: w_c256_done, w_c256_result

interfaces.name: Random bits to the masked core
AXI4 subordinate interface (CLK-CORE)
interfaces.signals: external manager -> IP: i_axi_awvalid, i_axi_awid, i_axi_awaddr, i_axi_awlen, i_axi_awsize, i_axi_awburst, i_axi_wvalid, i_axi_wdata, i_axi_wstrb, i_axi_wlast, i_axi_bready, i_axi_arvalid, i_axi_arid, i_axi_araddr, i_axi_arlen, i_axi_arsize, i_axi_arburst, i_axi_rready; IP -> external manager: o_axi_awready, o_axi_wready, o_axi_bvalid, o_axi_bid, o_axi_bresp, o_axi_arready, o_axi_rvalid, o_axi_rid, o_axi_rdata, o_axi_rresp, o_axi_rlast

interfaces.name: APB4 completer interface (CLK-APB)
interfaces.signals: external manager -> IP: i_apb_psel, i_apb_penable, i_apb_pwrite, i_apb_paddr, i_apb_pwdata, i_apb_pstrb, i_apb_pprot, i_protect_en, i_slverr_en; IP -> external manager: o_apb_pready, o_apb_pslverr, o_apb_prdata

interfaces.name: External DMA handshake (CLK-CORE)
interfaces.signals: IP -> DMA controller: o_dma_in_req, o_dma_out_req; DMA controller -> IP: i_dma_in_ack, i_dma_out_ack

interfaces.name: Entropy input (CLK-CORE)
interfaces.signals: external source -> IP: i_ent_valid, i_ent_data; IP -> external source: o_ent_req

interfaces.name: Clocks and resets
interfaces.signals: SoC -> IP: i_clk_core, i_rst_n_core, i_clk_apb, i_rst_n_apb

legend_note: The frame is the top module; blocks are its instances. Optional blocks exist only when their parameter selects them. Clocks and resets reach every block; bus links to the SHA-512 and Keccak cores are in section 5.1.
